steps.text:
The wall coat hook is built in the project as "Wall coat hook." It is a watertight solid with the back plate standing up and the 12 mm arm lying flat on the bed, so it should print without supports. I have not sliced or sent it to the printer.

- **Back plate:** 25 by 70 by 5 mm, with two M4 countersunk holes 40 mm apart on the front face.
- **Arm:** 12 mm round, 50 mm from the wall to the tip centerline, bending up with a 10 mm radius.
- **Tip:** 20 mm rise with a 6 mm rounded dome.

The guesses, which you can change in Model: 10 mm bend radius, 20 mm rise, 40 mm hole spacing, and an 8.4 mm countersink head. The 4.5 mm clearance hole came from the Albany County Fasteners chart. The formal plan check did not run because the plan ID did not match, so I checked the geometry directly instead: the bounds, watertight status and volume all look right.

Next step: I can slice it on your P1S with PLA and 0.4 mm, and send it to the printer when you say so.
